title: Battle
description: content/battles/<id>/battle.json: the battle's identity, map setup and sources. PLAN.md section 8.7. Positions everywhere in the battle folder are [x, y] in this file's field units; grid squares like "C4" are worked out from them, so the screen grid and the sand table always agree.

date.description: First (or only) day of the battle.

endDate.description: Last day, for multi-day battles such as Westport (Oct 21–23, 1864).

sides.description: Who fought. Unit and arrow "side" values must come from this list.

subgroups.description: Sub-shades within a side, e.g. McCulloch's Confederates vs. Price's Missouri State Guard.

field.description: The tactical map's coordinate space. The Cowpens prototype uses 600 × 900 yards with the Americans at the top.

orientationNote.description: e.g. "North is to the right; Americans at the top facing southeast."

grid.description: Lettered columns and numbered rows, matching the sand table string grid. columns × cellSize must equal field.width, and rows × cellSize must equal field.height.

columns.description: Labeled A, B, C… from the left.

positionsDisclaimer.description: Shown on every phase, e.g. "Positions approximate, after the Combat Studies Institute staff ride guide (1996)."

watchLinks.description: Leader prep links such as the American Battlefield Trust animated maps. Link only; never embed.
